findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair at the kitchen hand sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
The prep sink was observed to have a drip from the faucet.  Ensure maintenance is called and the sink faucet is repaired.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Fan used in dish area was observed to have a small amount of dust accumulation.  PIC was informed, the fan was removed and stated it will be cleaned today.  Ensure non-food contact surfaces are frequently cleaned to prevent build-up of dust and debris.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) and (B)  (P) Ranch dressing labeled "keep refrigerated" is 47°F internal and 57-58 along edge. Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 41°F, or less. Reviewed cold holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was rapidly chilled to less than 41°F ranch was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B).

A gallon and a half of ranch was voluntarily discarded.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Replace acoustic ceiling tiles througout kitchen and employee restroom with smooth, easily cleanable non-absorbent ceiling tiles.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
UPON NEXT REMODEL- Replace acoustic ceiling tiles throughout kitchen with smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent ceiling tiles.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food prepartion areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Ceiling tiles are acoustic and absorbent. Upon Next Remodel - Replace tiles with ones that are smooth and easily cleanable.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment:
At 12:30pm, a pan of cooked chicken was found in the pass-thru warmer unit at 122 degrees F.  CORRECTED - It was determined that chicken was greater than 135 approximately 1 hour prior.  Staff intended to rapidly cool chicken for later use.  Rapid cooling began, and food will be below 70 degrees F by 1:30pm.  Proper rapid cooling discussed.  See HACCP topic.

750-150(b)  Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135°F or above except during the cooling process. Store hot foods at 135°F or above. 
750-140(b)  Cooked potentially hazardous foods shall be properly cooled from >135 to 70°F within 2 hours and from 70°F to 41°F or below within 4 hours.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Three wet cloths were found in various places in kitchen, stored on various counter tops and sinks.  CORRECTED - before end of inspection, staff hung all soiled wet cloths to dry.  Store cloths either clean and dry, or within sanitizer solution.

750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. 
Observed 2 containers of milk stored on the floor of the walk in cooler. Store food 6" off of the floor to protect against potential contamination.
Properly store and protect food.
CORRECTED= Milk was placed on shelf.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. 
Observed the floor behind the big soup kettle and convection ovens to be soiled.
Clean the floors.

findings.comment:
